name: Kato

materials.shell: CNC metal (brass or stainless steel versions)

pros: Spacious soundstage for a single DD
cons: Price is higher than many single-DDs
insight: Kato is widely regarded as one of Moondrop’s most polished single-dynamic IEMs. The all-metal build, interchangeable nozzles, and spacious presentation make it a favorite among listeners who want a refined, stage-oriented single-DD experience.
